name: Gochuumon wa Usagi Desu ka?? Wonderful Party!
original_name: ご注文はうさぎですか?? Wonderful party!
source:
In the original four panel comic, the main character Cocoa arrives at the cafe Rabbit House one day, excited for rabbits. She actually all but lives in that café. She meets lots of different girls there, including a tiny and cool girl named Chino, a tough and soldier-esque girl named Rize, a spacey and quintessentially Japanese girl named Chiya, and the ordinary but dignified Sharo.

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2015-10-14/is-the-order-a-rabbit-game-revealed-for-ps-vita/.94178]Anime News Network[/url]]

Gameplay of Wonderful Party is divided into 2 parts that illustrating the daily life of Rabbit House Cafe. In the first one, player need to enliven the shop in order to prepare Chino's birthday party. The main focus in this part is to set up the  shop and dialogue between characters. While the second part, player must set up the shop for a Christmas party. In this part, player will play as Cocoa and story will focuses on which character Cocoa developing a relationship the highest with.
translation:
在原作四格漫画中，主人公保登心爱某天来到Rabbit House咖啡店，对兔子充满期待。实际上，她几乎就住在那家咖啡店里。她在那里遇见许多女孩：娇小冷静的香风智乃、坚强而像军人的天天座理世、迷迷糊糊又极具日本风情的宇治松千夜，以及平凡却端庄的桐间纱路。

[来源：[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2015-10-14/is-the-order-a-rabbit-game-revealed-for-ps-vita/.94178]Anime News Network[/url]]

《Wonderful Party》的玩法分为两部分，描绘Rabbit House咖啡店的日常生活。第一部分中，玩家需要让店铺热闹起来，为智乃准备生日派对，重点是布置店铺以及角色间的对话。第二部分中，玩家要为圣诞派对布置店铺；这部分将扮演心爱，故事会聚焦于她与哪名角色发展出最深的关系。
